name: handler_pbmcapply
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via 'pbmcapply' Progress Bars (Text) in the Terminal

origin.description: Build a progression handler that draws a pbmcapply bar.
origin.usage: handler_pbmcapply(char = "=", substyle = 3L, style = "ETA", file = stderr(), intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.terminal", 1), target = "terminal", ...)

arguments.name: char
arguments.text: Symbols for the bar. The default is "=".

arguments.name: substyle
arguments.text: Integer substyle passed to the pbmcapply bar. The default is 3.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: Connection for the bar. The R default is stderr(), evaluated only after the package lookup.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".
Named arguments for the bar, after make_progression_handler() arguments are dropped.

origin.details: Named backend arguments are collected first. pbmcapply::progressBar is then looked up and the call stops.
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_pbmcapply(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_pbmcapply() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would draw a pbmcapply bar.
translation.usage: handler_pbmcapply(char="=", substyle=3, style="ETA", file=None, intrusiveness=None, target="terminal", **extra)

arguments.name: char
arguments.text: Symbols for the bar. The default is "=".

arguments.name: substyle
arguments.text: Integer substyle passed to the pbmcapply bar. The default is 3.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: Connection for the bar. The R default is stderr(), evaluated only after the package lookup.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".
Named arguments for the bar, after make_progression_handler() arguments are dropped.

translation.details: Backend arguments are checked, then the call stops because pbmcapply is not installed.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
